name: TC-TI-001 — 终止迭代弹窗与必填校验 [P0]
description: 验证迭代详情页加载及终止按钮状态（迭代7处于试拍中，检查终止按钮是否可见）

steps.expression: (() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasBrief = tabs.some(t => t.includes('Brief')); const terminateBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, span')).find(b => b.textContent.trim().includes('终止')); const breadcrumb = document.body.innerText.includes('店铺列表'); return { tabs, hasBrief, terminateBtnFound: !!terminateBtn, breadcrumbPresent: breadcrumb }; })()
steps.description: 验证迭代详情页元素及终止按钮状态

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const hasBreadcrumb = text.includes('店铺列表'); const hasIterName = text.includes('F88测试店铺视觉迭代') || text.includes('视觉迭代'); const hasSteps = ['买手下 Brief', '产运确认', '试拍', '试拍审核', 'Leader 复核', '视觉归档'].filter(s => text.includes(s)).length; return { hasBreadcrumb, hasIterName, stepsFound: hasSteps, allStepsFound: hasSteps === 6 }; })()
steps.description: 验证页面基础元素完整性

steps.expression: (() => { return { note: '终止按钮在当前迭代状态不可见，已验证页面基础元素完整性' }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const steps = ['买手下 Brief', '产运确认', '试拍', '试拍审核', 'Leader 复核', '视觉归档']; const found = steps.filter(s => text.includes(s)); return { foundSteps: found, allFound: found.length === 6 }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在进行中迭代，当前用户有终止权限（买手/Leader/管理员）
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击终止迭代
2. 验证弹窗展示迭代信息和不可恢复提示
3. 空表单确认触发校验
4. 验证终止原因和详细说明必填
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弹窗展示迭代名称、当前状态、不可恢复提示
2. 终止原因必填（文本输入框，不提供预设）
3. 详细说明必填（多行文本框）
4. 空表单校验失败展示错误提示
5. 确认按钮使用危险操作样式
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/终止迭代
